source.collectionMethod: Publicly rendered Squarespace image URLs; unparameterized CDN URLs requested for originals
source.transforms: Archival originals are preserved byte-for-byte outside public. AVIF/WebP/JPEG runtime derivatives are resized into bounded boxes with EXIF orientation applied; thumbnails use aspect-preserving integer dimensions within a maximum 640x480 box, without cropping or enlargement. No colour retouching or proof manipulation.
source.runtimeFallbackPolicy: Use AVIF first, WebP second, and the optimized public JPEG fallback last. Thumbnails are listing previews only; archival originals are never runtime fallbacks.
